Priya Desai: FYI - Mira Therapeutics asking for a ramp concession on a 12mo Dedicated commit. Proposal: 15% off for first 2 invoices + $25k onboarding credit. They also want Net60 and temporary removal of usage cap for ~45 days while they finish integration.
Samir Patel: How big is the commit? ARR impact?
Priya Desai: 60k/mo reserved GPU pool starting 2026-06-15. ARR ~ $720k. Onboarding overage from pilot ~ $22k (they want that credited).
Janelle (RevOps): 15% for 2 months + Net60 + cap removal is outside playbook. Need Deal Desk approval and legal to weigh in on payment terms.
Lina Chen (Account Exec): Procurement pushed Net60, it's their standard cadence. They will provide a PO but asked if we can invoice on Net60 instead of PO-first.
Samir Patel: Credit exposure is non-trivial. Suggest conditional approval: 15% x 2 months, onboarding credit capped at $25k, require an upfront DSO mitigation fee ($12k suggested) and an escrow or pre-fund equal to 40% of one months commit held for first 60 days. Clawback if usage >150% of baseline in that window.
Janelle (RevOps): Sounds reasonable. Please capture as quick summary for Deal Desk: 
``
Deal: Mira Therapeutics
Commit: 60k/mo reserved (12mo)
Concession requested: 15% off first 2 invoices + $25k onboarding credit
Payment: Net60 (one-time exception)
Operational ask: lift usage cap for 45 days
Conditions: $12k DSO fee + 40% month pre-fund escrow; clawback if usage >150% baseline
```
Priya Desai: tagging Legal for Net60 + PO flow: @LegalBot
FinanceBot: Deal submitted to Approval Queue as DD-4921. Status: pending finance & legal review.
LegalBot: Quick note 1 - Net60 is fine with a confirmed PO and standard termination-for-nonpayment clause. If they cannot provide a PO up-front, require signed acknowledgment of invoice schedule and escrow mechanics. Also advise adding language specifying onboarding credit ceiling and clawback triggers.
Samir Patel: I can approve finance side contingent on Receipt of: PO or signed invoice schedule, $12k fee payment, and escrow pre-fund. Once docs are in, I'll sign.
Janelle (RevOps): I'll approve conditionally as well. Please record DD-4921 in the Deal Desk sheet and update the "concessions" column. :white_check_mark:
Lina Chen (Account Exec): I'll get the PO and written acknowledgement from their CFO today.
Priya Desai: Thanks all - I'll draft the contract addendum with the clauses Legal suggested and send for signatures.
Samir Patel: Finalize when PO + escrow + fee received. Finance will log the approved concession and update billing flags to auto-revert rates after month 2.
FinanceBot: DD-4921 updated: awaiting PO + escrow confirmation.
Priya Desai: Noted — will ping once PO is uploaded. :thumbsup:
